anomalies.observed: On the FCC Peripherals sheet, the Winbond NAND FLASH part U1 (W25N01GVZEIG_TR) has its HOLD_(IO3) pin (pin 7) wired directly to the GND symbol (the same ground node as the EP/pin 4), while WP_(IO2) (pin 6) is driven by a net (NET0160).
anomalies.expected: The active-low HOLD# input of the W25N01GV must be held high (tied to 3V3 or pulled up) for the device to be operable; the specification lists this part as the FCC-side 'FLASH Memory' and expects it to function. Sound practice (and the WP# handling on the same part) requires HOLD# not be grounded.

evidence.quote: FCC Peripherals sheet: U1 W25N01GVZEIG_TR, pin 7 'HOLD_(IO3)' wire runs to the GND symbol below the device
'FCC-side FLASH | FCCPeripherals | Winbond W25N01GVZEIG_TR (1 Gb NAND)' ... note 'FLASH Memory'

anomalies.impact: With HOLD# tied low, the NAND flash is permanently placed in hold state; its serial interface cannot respond, so the FCC cannot read or write the flash memory.
